title: Snail waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Snail body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='82' rx='38' ry='10' fill='#7ED957'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='80' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#8BE87F'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='78' rx='36' ry='7' fill='#9CF58F'/>
  <!-- Snail foot bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='86' rx='36' ry='6' fill='#5CB84A'/>
  <!-- Shell -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='22' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='18' fill='#FFA55E'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='13' fill='#FFB878'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='8' fill='#FFCC99'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='3' fill='#FFE0B8'/>
  <!-- Shell spiral highlight -->
  <path d='M 38 62 Q 44 56 48 62 Q 48 68 42 68' fill='none' stroke='#FFD4A8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head/neck reaching up -->
  <path d='M 58 76 Q 62 68 64 54 Q 65 46 63 40' fill='none' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 58 76 Q 62 68 64 54 Q 65 46 63 40' fill='none' stroke='#9CF58F' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='38' r='9' fill='#8BE87F'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='37' r='8' fill='#9CF58F'/>
  <!-- Eye stalks -->
  <line x1='60' y1='32' x2='56' y2='22' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='32' x2='70' y2='22' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eye stalk tips -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='20' r='1.8' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='1.8' fill='#B8860B'/>
  <!-- Mouth smile -->
  <path d='M 59 40 Q 63 44 67 40' fill='none' stroke='#4CAF3A' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#FFB0B0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#FFB0B0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Waving arm -->
  <path d='M 68 64 Q 76 58 82 48' fill='none' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 68 64 Q 76 58 82 48' fill='none' stroke='#9CF58F' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Waving hand -->
  <circle cx='83' cy='46' r='4.5' fill='#9CF58F'/>
  <!-- Fingers -->
  <line x1='82' y1='42' x2='80' y2='38' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='84' y1='41' x2='85' y2='37' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='86' y1='43' x2='89' y2='40' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='87' y1='47' x2='91' y2='46' stroke='#7ED957' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Motion lines near waving hand -->
  <path d='M 88 52 Q 90 50 89 47' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 90 55 Q 93 52 91 48' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
